############################################################################
#
#   PX4 uavcannode implementation based on DroneCAN libcanard
#
############################################################################

if(CONFIG_DRIVERS_UAVCANNODE_CANARD)

# Reuse the libcanard target from uavcan_canard (if enabled), otherwise build it locally.
if(NOT TARGET dronecan_libcanard)
	set(LIBCANARD_DIR ${PX4_SOURCE_DIR}/src/drivers/uavcan_canard/libcanard)

	add_library(dronecan_libcanard STATIC
		${LIBCANARD_DIR}/canard.c
	)

	# On NuttX, <time.h> includes <nuttx/config.h>, which is generated by the nuttx_context target.
	# The canonical dependency in PX4 is prebuild_targets -> nuttx_context.
	if(TARGET prebuild_targets)
		add_dependencies(dronecan_libcanard prebuild_targets)
	elseif(TARGET nuttx_context)
		add_dependencies(dronecan_libcanard nuttx_context)
	endif()

	target_compile_definitions(dronecan_libcanard PUBLIC
		CANARD_ENABLE_CUSTOM_BUILD_CONFIG=1
	)

	target_include_directories(dronecan_libcanard PUBLIC
		${LIBCANARD_DIR}
		${PX4_SOURCE_DIR}/src/drivers/uavcan_canard
	)
endif()

px4_add_module(
	MODULE drivers__uavcannode_canard
	MAIN uavcannode_canard
	SRCS
		uavcannode_canard_main.cpp
		UavcannodeCanard.cpp
		UavcannodeCanard.hpp
	DEPENDS
		dronecan_libcanard
		drivers_bootloaders
		px4_platform
	)

endif()
